description: This PHP source file defines the FilterParser class used for parsing filter parameters in a JSON API context within the SuiteCRM project. It includes methods for parsing filter keys and values, converting field keys into nested structures, and handling operators in filter expressions.

classes.name: FilterParser
classes.description: A class responsible for parsing filter expressions in a JSON API context, supporting nested field paths and operator handling.

methods.name: parseFilter
methods.description: Parses a filter key and value into a structured array, handling predefined filters and nested field filters.

methods.name: parseFieldKey
methods.description: Parses a filter field key, converting dotted notation into a nested array structure.

methods.name: splitFieldKeys
methods.description: Converts a dotted field key string into a nested associative array representing the hierarchy.

methods.name: parseFieldFilter
methods.description: Parses filter values, handling operators and operands, supporting multiple values separated by commas.

methods.name: splitValues
methods.description: Splits a string of comma-separated values into an array.

methods.name: isInOperatorsArray
methods.description: Checks if a given operator string matches any operator in a provided array of OperatorInterface objects.

methods.name: stringDifference
methods.description: Computes the character difference between two strings.

methods.name: mergeValueToFilterKey
methods.description: Merges filter values into the nested filter key structure.
